name: Weekly Status Reporter
description: Prepares weekly team status reports from notes and KPI data. Drafts the report, captures your review and edits, then formats the final version for distribution.

steps.label: Draft Weekly Status Report
steps.description: ANTON drafts the weekly status report from your inputs.

steps.label: Review & Approve Report
steps.description: Review ANTON's draft. Add details, corrections, or approve as-is.

config.checkpointMessage: Review the drafted status report. Add any missing information, corrections, or additional context before finalising.

inputFields.label: Corrections or additions
inputFields.placeholder: Paste any corrections or additional content to incorporate (leave blank if the draft is correct as-is)...

steps.label: Finalise and Format Report
steps.description: ANTON incorporates your edits and produces the final distribution-ready version.
